incident-bot: PagerDuty -> SEV2: abnormal token inflation for tenant `northstarmed` in dedicated-pool-ns-03. Alert: token_rate_spike > 200% over baseline. Affected routes: /v1/generate (gptx-13b-legacy). Rules triggered: tokenizer-encoding-mismatch. Link: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/1758004321 :rotating_light:

sara-ops: I'm on pager. pulling logs now. which cluster?

devon-ml: I'm looking at the sampled requests. earliest batch shows inputs ~1k chars -> tokenized 6xx tokens but previous correct runs were ~1xx tokens. snippet from logs:

```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z tenant=northstarmed req_id=abc123 model=gptx-13b-legacy input_chars=1024 tokens_reported=620
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z tenant=northstarmed req_id=def456 model=gptx-13b-legacy input_chars=1030 tokens_reported=625
```

Seems like a 3-4x inflation. looking for any header overrides.

javier-platform: I see routing metadata: client sends header `X-Text-Encoding: utf16` on a subset of requests. older model adapter assumed utf8 normalization; if tokenizer treats raw bytes as utf8 we can get inflated token counts. also these requests are pinned to dedicated-pool-ns-03 (northstarmed dedicated VPC).

anya-support: Customer reported a sudden billing spike and 429s hitting their app. Customer: NorthStarMed (prod). They called support at 09:18; asking for immediate mitigation and billing help. ETA from customer side: urgent.

sara-ops: can we isolate them to a fallback encoder or throttle? I can flip routing for that tenant to `encoder-v2-normalize` which will normalize utf16 -> utf8 before tokenization. Patch plan: toggle route -> restart adapter pods for the tenant config. Command: ```
# toggle tenant encoder
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/v1/tenants/northstarmed/route" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL" -d '{"encoder":"encoder-v2-normalize"}'
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: started canary rollout to 2 pods in dedicated-pool-ns-03 for config change (canary id c-773). Monitor logs for token_rate and token_cost.

devon-ml: quick investigation: encoding mismatch is the culprit. The client actually sends UTF-16LE payload in multipart form. our tokenizers expect normalized unicode string; the adapter earlier committed for speed passed through bytes into byte-level tokenizer (old char-encoding shortcut). Proposed minimal fix: normalize encoding at adapter entrypoint. patch (Python):

```python
# adapter/ingest.py
def normalize_text(payload_bytes, encoding_hint=None):
    if encoding_hint == 'utf16' or looks_like_utf16(payload_bytes):
        text = payload_bytes.decode('utf-16le')
    else:
        text = payload_bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    return text
```

This reduces tokens back to expected range in local repro.

javier-platform: I'm rolling the hotfix to the tenant adapter in the private control plane. Steps applied: 1) enable encoder-v2-normalize route for northstarmed 2) deploy adapter hotfix to the tenant pool 3) restart 3 adapter pods (graceful). Executed commands: ```
# enable route
kubectl --context=ns-03 patch configmap tenant-northstarmed --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/encoder","value":"encoder-v2-normalize"}]'
# restart adapter
kubectl --context=ns-03 rollout restart deploy/northstarmed-adapter
```

robin-oncall: taking handoff for the next 30m. ping me if token_rate or 5xxs spike. setting oncall -> @robin-oncall :bell: 

billing-bot: Automated note: detected anomalous billing delta for tenant northstarmed: +320% token units in last 15m. Queued reversal flag; awaiting manual approval from finance. Case ID FIN-2026-114.

anya-support: I sent an interim note to the customer: "We've identified a tokenization encoding mismatch causing inflated token counts for some requests. We've applied a routing workaround and are rolling a hotfix. We'll reverse any erroneous overage charges for the affected window and follow up with a full postmortem." Customer responded :thumbsup:.

sara-ops: Can confirm metrics: token_rate ratio (reported/expected) dropped from ~3.2x -> ~1.05x within ~6 minutes of the canary finishing. No additional 429s seen for the tenant. Logs: 

```
2026-03-15T09:25:07Z tenant=northstarmed tokens_reported=118 expected_est=112
2026-03-15T09:26:12Z tenant=northstarmed tokens_reported=120 expected_est=115
```

devon-ml: pushing follow-ups: 1) add encoding header validation to public API and warn customers if non-utf8 encodings used; 2) update SDKs to normalize to utf-8 at client side; 3) add test coverage for utf16 payloads in model onboarding. I'll own the changes and open PRs.

javier-platform: ops actions: schedule a migration to make encoder-v2-normalize default across dedicated pools; add config test in CI for tenant routing. Also we'll add a metric `tokenization_encoding_mismatch` to alert before billable token spikes.

billing-bot: Billing reversal pre-approved for SEV incidents; applied credit: tenant northstarmed credit=USD 1,240.00 reason="tokenization encoding mismatch". Notified finance (FYI). Case FIN-2026-114 updated.

anya-support: Customer follow-up plan: send concise incident summary, temporary credit confirmation, and timeline within 2 hours.

sara-ops: marking incident as mitigated. assigning postmortem: devon-ml (owner). Action items: postmortem due in 72h; follow up on SDK client changes; add CI test.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> monitoring. closing page. If token_rate_spike reappears for northstarmed reopen. :white_check_mark:
